Entries.Title: There's No Freaking Way I'll Be Your Lover! Unless...
Entries.Description: Renako starts high school determined to leave her introverted self behind and miraculously lands in the top-tier popular group. But keeping up the extrovert act is exhausting. Just as she’s about to break, the school’s princess, Mai Ouzuka, confesses to her!? This isn’t the high school life she imagined!

Episodes.Title: Girlfriends? No Freaking Way!
Episodes.Description: Renako starts high school determined to leave her introverted self behind and miraculously lands in the top-tier popular group. But keeping up the extrovert act is exhausting. Just as she’s about to break, the school’s princess, Mai Ouzuka, confesses to her!? This isn’t the high school life she imagined!

Episodes.Title: First Kiss?! No Freaking Way!
Episodes.Description:
The showdown between Renako and Mai has begun: best friend or girlfriend?

Mai visits Renako as a “friend,” and they have a blast. Friendship is the best!  But Mai’s feelings keep growing. Hoping to prove friendship wins, Renako plans a fun weekend outing. Everything's going great… until a sudden downpour flips everything on its head!?

Episodes.Title: You Can't Freaking Force Me!
Episodes.Description:
Renako tries to forget the kiss, while Mai leaves for work in Paris. Renako walks home with Ajisai after school, holding hands and making plans to hang out later, too. Mai calls her a cheater, but they're not even dating, so how can she be?!

But then when Ajisai comes over, Mai shows up too, bringing her little sister Haruna. Now it’s a chaotic four-person hangout... What could possibly go wrong?

Episodes.Title: Mai?! No Freaking Way! (...Or Maybe?)
Episodes.Description: Mai skips school, and Renako starts to worry... Maybe she really went too far. But then Satsuki calls her in to reveal the truth. Turns out, a heartbroken Mai told her something crazy... She's planning to join a Suitors Party?! How did it come to this?! Renako rushes to the hotel venue, where she and Mai face off… in swimsuits. Now’s the time. Renako has to finally tell Mai how she really feels!

Episodes.Title: Girlfriends? No Freaking Way! (Round 2)
Episodes.Description: Satsuki suddenly drops a bomb: “Let’s be girlfriends.”  It’s clearly revenge for Mai's careless treatment of her. Still, Renako agrees to play along for two weeks if it helps the two make up.  But why does Ajisai seem bothered? No way… right? Meanwhile, Mai’s as calm as ever. Things are shifting with Satsuki, but is it really headed in the right direction?

Episodes.Title: Too Many Freaking Secrets!
Episodes.Description:
Satsuki suddenly starts acting all couple-y in front of Mai, much to Renako's confusion. After seeing an unexpected side of Satsuki, Renako dares to admit she's actually an introvert, only to find out Satsuki already knew. Shocked, Renako runs off, but Satsuki finds her, and somehow she ends up spending the night at Satsuki’s place.

Are they really taking a bath together too!?

Wait, why!?

Episodes.Title: No Freaking Way I’m Surviving This Mess!
Episodes.Description: Thanks to Ajisai-san, Mai finally agrees to talk with Satsuki, and Renako gets roped in as a witness. Just when it seems like they’ll make up, Satsuki drops a secret photo of her and Renako! Wait, what?! Things spiral out of control and somehow it’s turned into an FPS showdown??! There’s no way Renako's losing… absolutely no way…!

Episodes.Title: A Perfect Win? No Freaking Way!
Episodes.Description: After their FPS practice, Renako stays the night at Satsuki’s. “Thanks for letting me face Mai,” Satsuki smiles, making Renako wish they’d just make up already. The long-awaited showdown begins! Mai’s flawless aim, Renako’s sharp instincts… and Satsuki struggling to keep up. But Renako can’t let her lose without a fight!

Episodes.Title: Visiting Ajisai’s House? No Freaking Way!
Episodes.Description: After the troubles with Satsuki settle down, Renako visits Ajisai over summer break... Only to realize that behind her gentle smile are hidden struggles. When Ajisai suddenly declares she’s running away, Renako decides to join her. Their destination: a hot spring! A fleeting summer escape that brings the two closer than ever.

But when he catches a glimpse of Fukami fresh out of the shower, he realizes—this guy is exactly his type! As they talk, they discover they have more in common than expected—including that they both like men. Could this be the start of something more?!

Episodes.Title: A guy to suit Mr.Perfect
Episodes.Description: Kaji, the ace of the sales department, has a secret—he's gay. But dating apps have been a bust, and finding his ideal match seems impossible. Then, one day, he's sent on an overnight business trip with Fukami, a quiet, unassuming guy from the engineering team. At first, Kaji isn't impressed. But when he catches a glimpse of Fukami fresh out of the shower, he realizes—this guy is exactly his type! As they talk, they discover they have more in common than expected—including that they both like men. Could this be the start of something more?!

Episodes.Title: What's Your Game, Zero?!
Episodes.Description: After returning from the business trip, Fukami keeps ignoring Kaji. No one on the dating apps looks a good as Fukami, though! Then, one evening, the two wind up alone together at the office. Fukami tries to leave as if nothing happened, leaving Kaji to say some pretty unexpected things to secure a second date.

Episodes.Title: Fukami and... a Girl?!
Episodes.Description: Kaji consoles a coworker who discovers he'd been dating a married man, and then happens to spot Fukami out with a lady as well, shopping for a ring! The stunned Kaji decides to ask the people at IT if Fukami has a fiancee, only to learn Fukami has been out for the last three days. A concerned Kaji heads to Fukami's house...

Episodes.Title: Say My Name
Episodes.Description: Kaji gets back the smartphone he left at Fukami's place—with Fukami's contact details snuck inside the case! Wanting to see if his feelings are the real deal, Kaji sets a date with Fukami for drinks. On the day of, however, Kaji is caught up by how cute Fukumi is, and things take them back to Kaji's place...

Episodes.Title: I Won't Go Easy On You!
Episodes.Description: Kaji is shocked to see Fukami's new haicut. But Kaji isn't the only one in the office to notice what Fukami has to offer. In a mere three days, he'd gone from a zero to a total ladies' man. Kaji is both annoyed and compelled by Fukami's obliviousness at his own appeal. Seizing the initiative, he ties up Fukami with his necktie...!

Episodes.Title: Sorry, I've Got a Cold
Episodes.Description: After walking home in the pouring rain after being pushed away by Fukami, Kaji has caught a cold. He falls asleep regretting how he told Fukami "We should stop seeing each other for a while." Awakening to the sound of someone calling his name, he sees a worried Fukami peering back at him. Caught up in the shock, Kaji graps Fukamiu close for a kiss...

Episodes.Title: I Couldn't Help But Be Attracted
Episodes.Description: Kaji thought he didn't need love in his life, but meeting Fukami changed that, and so he refuses to just give in. After a simple honest mistake, Kaji's coworker tells him he's just fine without being perfect. Kaji wonders how those words might strike Fukami, and begins to reminisce about their times together...

Episodes.Title: Is It So Bad if I Fall in Love?
Episodes.Description: Kaji goes to see Fukami at the hospital only to be asked what relation he has to the patient. Tears begin to come as he searches for an answer. Realizing how important Fukami truly is to him, the man himself appears right behind him! The two proceed to clear up their miscommunication, and make progress toward to putting aside ill will...

At the Adventurer’s Guild, Beryl ends up in a duel with her to prove he has what it takes for the job. He isn’t really happy with the turn of events, but Surena seems to feel differently.

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Takes Flight With a Monster
Episodes.Description: To protect the new adventurers, Beryl faces off against a dangerous monster. Unlike other opponents, it acts on instinct, and he’s drawn into a ferocious battle, unable to get a read on its moves. Later on, he faces an encounter that will turn his future upside down.

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Gets Enraged by the Bad Guys

With the help of Allucia and Lucy, he strives to help her free herself from the clutches of shadowy forces and the evil that binds her.

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Faces the Dead

Religion and international relations come to the forefront, and with no ties that might cause an international incident, Beryl is asked to flush out the mastermind. New sword in hand, Beryl battles for Mewi’s future.

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Learns the Challenges of Parenting

When they find out that the magic institute Mewi is enrolled at has a student dormitory, Beryl wonders whether it is best for her to live with him, or on campus.

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Gets Struck by a Lightning-Fast Sword
Episodes.Description: When a delegation from a neighboring country arrives, Allucia asks Beryl to help guard the VIPs, and he can’t refuse. Beryl needs the right clothes for the job, so he and Allucia go shopping. It’s just like a date! The next day, Allucia approaches Beryl with an offer.

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Goes on His First Hunt in Ages
Episodes.Description: Mewi needs a new bag for school, so Beryl goes shopping. But he quickly realizes just how expensive bags can be! A job offer from Surena provides a means to make some extra cash, and he jumps at the chance. But he soon realizes – this job is one even high-ranking adventurers have never completed!

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Guards a Princess
Episodes.Description: The Vice Commander of the Holy Order of the Church of Sphene is Beryl’s former student, Rose, and he renews his ties with her. When the delegation arrives, Beryl is assigned to guard the two royal families as they tour the capital. But a shadow looms over what is supposed to be a joyous event.

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Throws Himself into a Deadly Fight
Episodes.Description: Beryl helps protect the royal family from assassins, but the assassins all kill themselves, and any clues to the mastermind are lost. Lucy thinks a conflict between royalty and religion is at play. Despite Beryl wanting to cancel the tour of the capital to keep the prince safe, the plan goes ahead.

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Gets Praised as a Master Swordsman
Episodes.Description: It was Rose behind the flood of assassins. Beryl confronts her in an effort to find where her true intentions lie. Rose tells him, and the two draw their swords against each other. What will the outcome be in this battle between master and student?

Entries.Title: The Share House's Secret Rule
Entries.Description: After Ryota moves into a share house, he finds himself living with two gorgeous housemates. At first, it seems like a dream come true, but he soon discovers that the two girls are incredibly lazy! Ryota’s patience quickly runs out, and decides to leave. But before he can go, the two make him an intriguing offer: “How about a new rule? For every chore you do, you get to touch us for one minute…”

Episodes.Title: My roommates are way too cute
Episodes.Description: After Ryota moves into a share house, he finds himself living with two gorgeous housemates. At first, it seems like a dream come true, but he soon discovers that the two girls are incredibly lazy! Ryota’s patience quickly runs out, and decides to leave. But before he can go, the two make him an intriguing offer: “How about a new rule? For every chore you do, you get to touch us for one minute…”

Episodes.Title: Come on... Touch me
Episodes.Description: Taking advantage of the "Touch Points" system his roommates suggested, Ryota and Momoka begin to get a bit closer. But after things go a little too far, the atmosphere between them turns awkward. Has Kanade noticed what’s going on? Either way, she doesn’t hold back—leaning in as Ryota massages her shoulders, she whispers, “Come on... touch me. For one minute, you can do whatever you want…”

Episodes.Title: I’ll do it for you...
Episodes.Description: Ryota uses his "Touch Points" with Kanade, and before he knows it, the two of them start getting hot and heavy... Given the recent developments, Ryota feels the dynamic with his two beautiful roommates shifting. Just then, Momoka decides it’s time to join in on the housework, declaring, “I have points from housework too... Now I'll do it for you…”

Episodes.Title: I'm just working out...!
Episodes.Description: After things heat up between Momoka and Ryota, she starts to feel embarrassed and begins avoiding him around the house. Ryota then hears a loud noise at the entrance—it’s Kanade, stumbling in, clearly drunk! With no other choice, Ryota helps her to her room. But as they reach her bed, Kanade, still tipsy, looks up at him and pleads, “Hey… you’ve still got some Touch Points left, right?”

Episodes.Title: They might hear me...
Episodes.Description: After learning that Momoka is being followed by a male student from her university, Ryota steps in to help by posing as her boyfriend to keep the stalker at bay. Though the plan succeeds, the stalker lashes out, and Ryota ends up injured while protecting her. Later, as Momoka cares for him in the hospital, the two find themselves closer than they’ve been in a long time.

Episodes.Title: You've had too much to drink...
Episodes.Description: After the restaurant that Kanade works at becomes short-staffed, she desperately asks Ryota for help. To his surprise, he encounters a completely different side of Kanade—responsible, hardworking, and mature—far from the lazy person he knows at the share house. As the night winds down, Kanade serves Ryota a drink. But after some time, a tipsy Ryota finds himself getting closer and closer to her.

Episodes.Title: We can’t do this in a movie theater...
Episodes.Description: Ryota and Kanade’s passionate connection continues to deepen, and it doesn't go unnoticed, even by Momoka. Sensing the growing tension between them, Momoka decides to invite Ryota to the movie theater to find out how he truly feels. However, Momoka ends up clinging to Ryota in fear of the scary movie. Overcome by the sight of her vulnerability, Ryota can’t help but give in to the moment.

Episodes.Title: One minute... There's no way I can stop...
Episodes.Description: Ryota overhears Momoka and Kanade talking in secret. Have they discovered that he's slept with both of them? But as if to chase away his worries, the girls suggest Ryota spend time together in the living room, with a very specific idea in mind. “Tonight, we'll fulfill one of your requests.” Ryota finds himself faced with a big decision... “One minute... There's no way I can stop...”

Entries.Description: CITY—something happens every day. Tsurubishi dives a crispy fried noodle into a customer's bag, while Nagumo witnesses it. An absolute, desperate situation! Episodes.Description: CITY—something happens every day. Tsurubishi dives a crispy fried noodle into a customer's bag, while Nagumo witnesses it. An absolute, desperate situation! Matsuri and Eri enjoying their after-school adventures. Todoroki and Onikamaboko struggle to create a joke for "Rakutan-kun." After hearing Niikura's dream, Nagumo starts thinking what they want to do. Something starting to blossom in CITY.

Perpetually broke Nagumo faces off against Niikura, who just wants her money back. When Wako joins in, their chaotic campus life kicks into high gear. Meanwhile, the CITY Minami Eleven soccer team scrambles to protect their always-injured ace, Sasago. Todoroki negotiates the fate of Rakutan-kun—testing the bond between editor and author. And the sun sets on CITY.

With a performance approaching, Tekaridake Theater's leader, Tekaridake, tries to rally his unmotivated troupe. Sleepwalker Riko Izumi steals the heart of 16-year-old Tatewaku Makabe. Spring is just around the corner. Matsuri and Eri share kindness to protect world peace. Nagumo, Niikura, and Wako find a treasure map—let the battle begin! Another peaceful day in CITY.

Tanabe loves handing out awards for anything and everything, and now she begins the search for Nagumo! Tsurubishi visits the izakaya 'Yamabushi,' eager to get the iconic 'Boss! The usual!' and starts frequenting it. Niikura chases after a pendant that got caught on a 'Mimineko.' Matsuri and Eri embark on a big adventure chasing the Mimineko. The lives of each person intersect in CITY.

Nagumo is taken away by Tanabe. Their destination is the Tanabe Residence Hospitality Twin Towers. With the help of a kind person they meet along the way, Nagumo and Wako try to escape, but the guardians on each floor block their path... Meanwhile, Niikura continues to run recklessly, chasing the Mimineko. Disconnected dots begin to connect in CITY!

The Adataras' morning is always busy. Umi, Sora, Kamome, Tatsuta, and Ryota, all head off together as usual. An anonymous manuscript titled 'Kanki-kun' arrives at the CITY magazine editorial office. Feeling something special about it, Todoroki makes a proposal to Onikamaboko. At the riverside at dusk, Eri tries to convey something to Matsuri... The seasons of CITY continue to change.

Taking over for the owner of Café Yamabushi, Tsurubishi sets out to make the ultimate fried rice. With pride, he embarks on a journey to find the perfect ingredients. Late night, Niikura is struck by hunger and eats whatever she can. Meanwhile, Kuratake, the barber known as “the baddest guy in CITY,” been selling off gifts from his regulars. In CITY, there's no light without a little darkness.

A girl in love can't stop sighing. After 18 years of waiting for an invitation, Tanabe finally learns his crush's favorite food?! Tekaridake casts Nagumo as the lead in "Throat". Despite endless NGs, he powers through—and the curtain rises! A police officer becomes a fan of Riko Izumi. Tatewaku, too, ends up asking her out. Something is blooming in CITY.

The CITY race with a 1-million-yen prize is on. Nagumo competes against Obaba. Niikura aims to steal pendant from the CITY Minami Eleven. Tekaridake runs with a pair in tow. Matsuri and Eri move in sync. The Three Crows hold fine sake in hand. With surprises at every turn, the unpredictable race keeps everyone on edge. Who will win the race? As everyone runs, CITY begins to spin!

Episodes.Description: On a midsummer's day, Tsuyoshi heads to the convenience store to get chuhai, and reunites with Ai Natsuno, his junior from high school. Ai is now married, with a huge makeover as a sun-kissed gyaru, but acts like a spoiled child around Tsuyoshi, just like she used to.

Episodes.Title: The Flavor of a Married Club Senpai's Lips
Episodes.Description: Tsuyoshi starts an online drinking session with his two guy friends, and the college idol senpai, Miki Kanzaki. As Miki gets drunk from canned chuhai and exposes herself on screen, Tsuyoshi and the gang can't take their eyes off her.

Episodes.Title: The Flavor of My Russian Friend's Sister's Lips
Episodes.Description: Tsuyoshi goes round Joseph's house and meets his older sister and married Russian beauty, Anastasia. The three have canned chuhai, but Anastasia gets dead drunk and mistakes Tsuyoshi for her younger brother. He ends up taking care of her, but...

Episodes.Title: The Flavor of a Mysterious, Tanuki-Faced Married Woman's Lips
Episodes.Description: One night when Tsuyoshi was wandering around town with canned chuhai in his hand, he meets a wild tanuki, and gets led to a big mansion. There he meets a tanuki-faced beauty, Tamami Miyazawa, who gives him a warm reception, but for a certain reason...

Episodes.Title: The Flavor of a Baby-Faced, Cheeky Married Woman's Lips
Episodes.Description: By chance, Tsuyoshi ends up having a one-night stand with Nozomi Kuji, a married woman who looks too young for her age. Since then, they've become canned chuhai drinking buddies. In the midst of this, Nozomi vents out her frustration about her busty-loving hubby, and Tsuyoshi gets lectured on the appeal of small breasts...

Episodes.Title: The Flavor of an Otherworldly, Married Dark Elf's Lips
Episodes.Description: Tsuyoshi enters a parallel universe and saves a dark elf beauty, Symphis with the skill he gained from the chuhai god. Tsuyoshi gradually becomes drawn to Symphis as she talks about her husband, but something doesn't add up...

Episodes.Title: The Flavor of a Quiet Former Rebel, the Barbershop Owner's Lips
Episodes.Description: As Tsuyoshi goes to his regular barbershop, the quiet forty-odd beauty owner, Sari Kirihara, announces that the shop will be closing down. Tsuyoshi ends up drinking canned chuhai at Sari's house without the presence of her husband, but realizing her secret feelings, tries to snuggle up to her...

Entries.Title: Witch Watch
Entries.Description: Morihito Otogi is a teenager with ogre strength. His childhood friend, Nico, is coming home after completing her witch training! Following an old pact, they begin living together. Can Morihito protect the clumsy Nico from a dire prophecy?

Episodes.Title: Witch's Return
Episodes.Description: Morihito Otogi is a teenager with ogre strength. His childhood friend, Nico, is coming home after completing her witch training! Following an old pact, they begin living together. Can Morihito protect the clumsy Nico from a dire prophecy?

Episodes.Title: A Giant Rookie / Let's Go to a Diner / The Flying Classroom
Episodes.Description: On the first day of school, Morihito urges Nico to hide the fact that she's a witch, but she tries using magic to secretly help him out in class.

Episodes.Title: Fresh Transparent Fashions for Spring / Witch's Delivery Service / Lost Dogs and the Patter of Rain
Episodes.Description: Nico's mother sends Morihito a letter containing a worrying prophecy. Unable to decipher the meaning, Morihito spends the rest of the day on his toes.

Episodes.Title: Kanshi Kazamatsuri, the Tengu
Episodes.Description: Kanshi explains that Nico's mother sent him to protect her. He and Morihito clash, but he takes a moment to warn him of an enemy within the school.

Episodes.Title: My Student Is My Favorite Artist / My Tummy Is Tender Today / Cat Scout
Episodes.Description: Closet manga fan Ms. Makuwa loses her composure when she realizes that one of her students is a popular fan artist for her favorite series.

Episodes.Title: Under the Lovers' Tree
Episodes.Description: After realizing Morihito is getting popular with the girls at school, Nico learns of a so-called lovers' tree near the site of an upcoming field trip.

Episodes.Title: Kan and Nico's Channel / The Tea Ceremony Is a Piece of Tea Cake
Episodes.Description: Nico and Kanshi start an online video channel, but Morihito is annoyed by their lack of originality and asks their hipster classmate Magami for help.

Episodes.Title: Kanshi’s Part-Time Job Diaries ~The Superhero Show~ / Kanshi’s Part-Time Job Diaries ~The Side Job~
Episodes.Description: When Kanshi can’t pay his share of the living expenses, Morihito hands him a flyer from an amusement park hiring performers for a superhero show.

Episodes.Title: Dear Kara / New Friends / Date with the Knight
Episodes.Description: Nico and Morihito's classmate Kara asks them to restore a letter from her deceased mother, which her father put through a paper shredder.

Episodes.Title: Trope-tacular Student Council / A Stray Cat’s Bubble of Bliss
Episodes.Description: After a student council vice president makes a dramatic entrance to forbid Nico from using magic, the council’s other larger-than-life members arrive.

Episodes.Title: Dogs and Raindrops (1)
Episodes.Description: Kanshi saves Keigo from a bully who claims to be using a candy with a stimulant effect. A self-proclaimed witch appears before Nico and Morihito.

Episodes.Title: Dogs and Raindrops (2)
Episodes.Description: A transformed Keigo attacks the isolated Morihito. Surrounded by Wolf's "Dogs," Kanshi and Nico devise a plan to locate and neutralize the warlock.

Episodes.Title: Keigo Magami, the Werewolf / Kind Tiger, Proud Wolf / Easy Spices for Enthralling Cooking
Episodes.Description: Morihito and the others decide to get rid of any crescent-shaped objects to minimize the risk of Keigo transforming into a werewolf in the house.

Episodes.Title: Uron Mirage Chapter 119: The Phasey Hunt, Part 4 / Diary of My Favorite Artist
Episodes.Description: In Episode 119 of Uron Mirage, swordsmen Utsuro, Oboro, Sagiri and Zack decide to split up and search the buildings of an abandoned research facility.

Episodes.Title: Summer Demon
Episodes.Description: Ibuki's newest prophecy advises seeking a family that dispels evil. Nico and her friends set out in search, treating the journey like a summer trip.

Episodes.Title: Miharu Kiryu, the Vampire / Missing Parasol / I'm So Glad You're Here
Episodes.Description: Vampire Miharu moves into the Otogi house, but as a night person with different energy needs, he may struggle to adjust to communal living.

Episodes.Title: We Got Trapped in a Death Game, But It Sucked / Long Long a Go Go
Episodes.Description: Morihito and the other guys awake in an unknown place. A mysterious figure tells them they must play a game — and that Nico is being held hostage.

Episodes.Title: Kara and Shiki / Mega Marble Mania Madness / Scramble Scrap Squad
Episodes.Description: Nico and Kukumi help Kara out at the shrine run by her father. When Nico casts a spell to make a paper cat move around, Kara gets an idea.

Episodes.Title: Letter from a Friend
Episodes.Description: When tidying the house, Morihito finds a letter Nico wrote to him when they were kids. Nico shares her memories of those days with Nemu and the guys.

Episodes.Title: The Lost Wolf and the Stray Cat
Episodes.Description: Noticing that Keigo seems sad, Nico gives him a ring imbued with a levitation spell. As he secretly trains to use it, Nemu approaches him.

Episodes.Title: Secret Urges / Keiko's Carefree Style / Jekyll Visits the Otogi House
Episodes.Description: As Keigo wonders why his channel isn't getting more views, Nico casts a spell on him that she believes will help make his videos more interesting.

Episodes.Title: The Incredible Shrinking Adventure / The Hamazaki Fall Bread Festival / Lucky Birthday
Episodes.Description: While sharing donuts with Kara and Morihito, Nico decides to shrink herself and Morihito down so they can experience eating a giant pastry.
